vector-antiderivative.def: An antiderivative of a vector-valued function, found one component at a time: $\int \left\langle f(t), g(t) \right\rangle\,dt = \left\langle F(t), G(t) \right\rangle + \mathbf{C}$, with a constant vector $\mathbf{C}$. An initial condition fixes $\mathbf{C}$; for position from velocity, $\mathbf{r}(t) = \mathbf{r}(0) + \int_0^t \mathbf{v}(s)\,ds$.
